said on Tuesday that its QNX division’s royalty backlog topped $1.2B, up more than $250M (26%) from ~$950M at 2026 fiscal year-end.
The growth reflects adoption of QNX Software Development Platform 8.0 and a first Alloy Kore design win valued at more than $100M in estimated future royalties.
QNX also secured design wins across robotics, industrial automation, and medical devices, expanding beyond automotive.
Note: Backlog is estimated future royalties, subject to production volumes and customer program changes.
On the market side, the stock slipped ~1.10% to ~$8.07 in the premarket session.

title: BlackBerry’s QNX backlog jumps 26% to $1.2B; shares fall premarket
